我们致力于以前沿AI深度重构企业核心流程，推动组织迈向智能决策。我们专注于打造具备思考、进化与决策能力的AI系统，并让每位成员成为它的“共创者”。

我们相信，未来组织的核心竞争力，在于人与AI持续协同进化的能力。

我们的实践
我们拥有由全球领先酒店管理集团提供的真实、复杂且全球化的“现实实验室”：

我们寻找的人才
我们正在寻找各领域的“AI共建者”——那些真正理解AI潜力，并渴望通过技术重塑工作、创造未来价值的行动派。

records.公司业务简介:
Metaprise is a New York-based AI infrastructure company.  — we build for the enterprise "Agent Operating System": the foundational layer that lets AI Agents autonomously execute tasks inside a company, record every decision, and hold up to regulatory audit. Our clients are US financial institutions and healthcare systems — organizations where compliance isn't optional and every automated action has consequences.
This is not a chatbot company. It is not a GPT wrapper. It is infrastructure.

Why this moment matters.
Enterprise software has been run by humans for fifty years. Approvals, escalations, cross-team handoffs, compliance checks — all of it designed around the assumption that a person is in the loop. That assumption is now breaking. AI Agents are beginning to execute those workflows autonomously, and the companies that build the governance layer for that transition will define how enterprise AI works for the next decade.
We are building that layer. We are early. And we are hiring.

What we believe.
We say what we mean. If a candidate isn't right, we tell them why. If a decision is wrong, we reverse it. We don't perform progress — we make it. The people who thrive here are the ones who find it more uncomfortable to stay quiet than to say something honest.
We also believe that the engineers who build this will be among the most consequential technical contributors of their generation. Not because we say so — because the problem is real, the timing is right, and the infrastructure doesn't exist yet.
If that sounds like something worth working on, read on.
